summary: Iteration 4 (schedules, phone SIM SMS outbox, Dexcom Share upload, Nightscout/Tidepool toggle-first, Libre 2/3 screens). Backend: new suite test_iter4_schedules_sms_dexcom.py (18 tests) + legacy suites = 79/79 pass. Covered ChannelSchedule windows (multi-window, per-weekday, day dedup/sort, old {start,end} migration to all-days window, mode=hours with empty windows gets default, 422 on bad day/time/mode), contact schedules, cloud mode without Twilio -> 400 'Twilio keys missing', phone mode -> 'Text to X handed to your phone' + outbox item, POST /sms/outbox/{id} marks done and logs 'Phone text to X failed: ...', bad ids 404, weekday window respected ('No call to X (outside the set hours)'), contact sms disabled -> 'off for this contact', dx_serial regex 422, /dexcom/upload no creds 400. FOUND+FIXED BUG: with fake Dexcom creds the API returned 400 'Dexcom Share rejected the upload (500).' instead of a login error, because Dexcom answers bad logins with HTTP 200 + session 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000; added a null-GUID check in uploads.py, now 'Dexcom login failed. Check username, password and region.'. Frontend (375x667 web): Nightscout/Tidepool show only the Upload toggle until on, then URL/secret and email/password (+ Upload now) appear and hide again when off; Master mode Dexcom Share toggle reveals username/password/region/serial; Voice calls ScheduleEditor Always/Custom hours, Weekend preset + day circle toggle, From/To hour/minute grids (22:30, 06:15), add window, remove window via trash, Save, reload shows same 2 windows (verified via API too). Contact sheet: Default/Always/Custom hours for text + call, Weekdays 08:00-17:00 saved, row shows 'Text always · Call Weekdays 08:00–17:00', persists after reload and re-opens with same values. Sensor: libre3 shows 'Libre 3 can't be read directly' card and 'Switch to LibreLinkUp' switches source to libre; libre2 on web shows 'Needs the installed app'. Alarm sound / glucose alarm / reminder sheets still open and close. SMS-via radio is Android-only (isAndroid) so not visible on web, as designed. No deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found; unstable-native-tabs no longer referenced. demo_user reset to em_sms_via=cloud, no contacts, original call/sms schedules and tz.

minor.issue: FIXED by tester: bad Dexcom creds produced 'Dexcom Share rejected the upload (500).' (Dexcom returns 200 + all-zero session id). Now raises 'Dexcom login failed...'.

Manual upload ignores source: with source=demo it pushes fake demo readings to the user's real Dexcom Share account (background loop correctly skips demo/dexcom). Also returns 200 {uploaded:0} without checking the login when there is nothing new to send, so wrong creds go unnoticed.

If the Android phone never drains the outbox (app killed, iPhone, Expo Go), pending texts silently expire after 30 min; the emergency log only says 'handed to your phone' and nothing ever records that it wasn't sent. Consider marking stale items failed + logging, or falling back to Twilio when keys exist.

ui_bugs.issue: When /sensor is opened directly (web reload/deep link) router.back() has no history and the back button does nothing; user is stuck. Use router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/settings'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/sensor.tsx:102

issues: Field label 'Call again every' wraps onto 3 lines in a narrow label column at 375px (EmergencySection.tsx:141)
Day circles are 40px tall and hour/minute cells minHeight 40 (< 44pt touch target)
WindowEditor uses key={i}; removing a window while another window's time grid is open shifts the open grid to the wrong window
'Needs the installed app' copy says 'real iPhone app ... TestFlight' even though Libre 2 NFC/BLE + SIM SMS are pitched for Android too

action_items: Dexcom manual upload: block (or warn) when source is demo so fake readings are never pushed to a real Dexcom Share account; optionally validate login even when nothing new to upload
Phone-SMS outbox: log a failure for items that expire undrained (and/or fall back to Twilio) so users know the text was never sent
sensor.tsx back button: fall back to router.replace('/settings') when !router.canGoBack()
Minor UI: widen label for 'Call again every', bump day circles/time cells to 44px, use stable keys for schedule windows
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is 752 lines (>700) even after the split; consider moving the data-source/sensor-session block into its own section component
Contacts added in the sheet only persist after tapping the header Save; works, but easy to lose changes if the user navigates away
Old-format migration only fires when 'start' is present and windows empty - fine for existing saves
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_xdrip_iter2.py (legacy assert updated to new windows format)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 minor back-button bug)

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users TEST_it4_* (per pytest worker) and TEST_fe4_ba4888 with TEST_ contacts. demo_user settings were changed during UI tests and restored afterwards (em_sms_via=cloud, em_contacts=[], call schedule 00:00-07:00 all days, sms always, tz UTC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/` (pytest.ini uses xdist; module api fixture in iter4 suite registers a fresh TEST_ user per worker, so it never touches demo_user). Dexcom Share returns HTTP 200 with session 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 for bad logins. Fresh users need POST /api/sync to get demo readings before /dexcom/upload does anything. SMS-via radios (emergency-sms-via-phone/cloud) only render on Android, not web. ContactSheet content is inside a ScrollView in a bottom sheet: scrollIntoView via JS before clicking. ScheduleEditor chip testIDs: {prefix}-always/-hours/-default; window: {prefix}-window-N, -day-0..6, -preset-Weekdays, -start, -start-hour-HH, -start-minute-MM, -remove, {prefix}-add-window. Python urllib calls to the public URL get 403 (use requests). Changing demo_user source away from demo deletes its demo readings - use TEST_ users for source/sensor tests.
rca_of_issue: Dexcom upload with wrong creds: uploads.upload_dexcom_share only checked r.status_code != 200 on LoginPublisherAccountByName; Dexcom returns 200 with an all-zero GUID for invalid accounts, so the code continued and every subsequent Publisher call returned 500, surfacing 'Dexcom Share rejected the upload (500)'. Mitigation applied: treat empty/all-zero session as login failure.
